summary: A paged product tour in a dialog, one step at a time, with a count or a progress bar.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: A glyph beside the trigger's label.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of the trigger its `triggerIcon` sits at.

props.name: steps

example.title: Welcome aboard
example.description: A short tour of what you can do here, three screens long.

example.title: Build your first page
example.description: Drop in a component, adjust its props, and watch it update.

example.title: Invite your team
example.description: Share a link and everyone edits the same draft.

props.description: Each step's `icon`, `title` and `description`. Steps advance one at a time and the dialog resets to the first when it closes.

props.name: indicator
props.description: `count` reads "1 / 3" in the header. `progress` draws a filling bar under the slide instead. `dots` moves navigation to a bottom row of step dots between prev/next arrows.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: An X in the corner, so the tour can be skipped without walking to the end.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the trigger, the popup and its controls.

props.name: animate
props.description: The slide transition between steps and the popup's scale-in. Turn it off for an instant tour, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the trigger's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them.
